items.description: A historic building in Lagos that served as the residence of the General Manager of the Nigerian Railway Corporation. It is an example of colonial architecture.
A multi-purpose stadium in Lagos, named after the footballer Teslim Balogun. It is a major sporting venue in Nigeria.
An agricultural area near the Benue River, focusing on crop production. It contributes significantly to local food security.
A highland region in Cross River State known for its temperate climate. It is a scenic area characterized by rolling hills.
A valley area along the Niger River, critical for irrigation and fishing. It forms a key part of the central Nigerian landscape.
A high volcanic plateau in northeastern Nigeria. It is known for its distinct elevation and basalt rock formations.
A mountain range on the border between Nigeria and Cameroon. It is defined by rocky terrain and deep valleys.
A remote mountain range located in Adamawa State. It is characterized by challenging terrain and limited access.
A high-altitude range in Plateau State near Jos. It is one of the highest points in Nigeria, popular for climbing.
A series of hills in Kogi State, situated at the confluence of the Niger and Benue rivers. It offers significant scenic views.
